raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ### What does this PR do? DeepSeek-V4 true-on-policy GRPO/DAPO on verl + mLite + vLLM. - **Composable actor, not a core patch:** built on Megatron Agent-Compose (mLite) under `experimental/lite/`. Model behavior is assembled through protocols and primitives instead of an invasive Megatron-core patch stack. The vLLM-aligned pieces can be reused by other models or swapped for a future SGLang path. - **W8A8:** BF16 master weights, E4M3 block-FP8 deployment weights, dynamic FP8 activations. Actor and rollout share the same W8A8 path after reload. - **Hopper and Blackwell:** validated on H100, GB200, and GB300. - **Preview dependencies, later split/merge:** https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54955, https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7050. - **Exact 0-diff logprobs:** after update and reload, `training/rollout_probs_diff_* == 0` and `rollout_corr/k3_kl == 0` — not an epsilon threshold. - **~10% perf overhead, still being optimized:** GB200 32-GPU, generate is nearly unchanged; the remaining gap is in the batch-invariant actor path. ### results ### Acknowledgements Thanks to [@zhuzilin](https://github.com/zhuzilin) and the contributors to [THUDM/slime#2262](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/pull/2262). ### Contributors - Yan Bai ([@ISEEKYAN](https://github.com/ISEEKYAN)): preview architecture, DS4 vLLM/mLite integration, deterministic execution, weight synchronization, recipe, and hardware validation. - [@aoshen02](https://github.com/aoshen02): vLLM verification and speedup. - Kaixiang Lei ([@shyoshyo](https://github.com/shyoshyo)): DeepSeek-V4 gradient checkpointing, HF export, THD label alignment, and microbatch output handling. - [@andakai](https://github.com/andakai) and [@zobinHuang](https://github.com/zobinHuang) optimized the performance of the batch-invariant vLLM execution path.

Updated the PR source branch in `640c5f0a` after validating the corresponding
vLLM revision (`ISEEKYAN/vllm@168a040e`, merged as ISEEKYAN/vllm#22).

Changes:
- build the vLLM wheel and unified BI CUDA extension from the same pinned source
  tree instead of combining an older wheel with a Python overlay;
- include the fused sparse-index CUDA source and record wheel/library hashes in
  an image-closure manifest;
- keep CUDA Graph at the vLLM default (`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`);
- do not enable MNNVL by default; only propagate it when the caller sets it.

Validation:
- pre-commit passed for both modified recipe files;
- unified ARM64 CUDA library build and 10/10 eager/CUDA-Graph bitwise operator
  comparisons passed;
- 8-node fixed-output rollout A/B used identical step-0 inputs (1,024 requests,
  8,388,608 response tokens): BI=0 45.7706 vs BI=1 43.3193 response tokens/ms,
  a 5.36% BI gap.

This updates the existing DS4 preview recipe rather than duplicating it. AI
assistance (OpenAI Codex) was used; the human maintainer should review the
changed lines and validation before merging.

Applied the changes from ISEEKYAN/verl#21 directly to this PR head branch, as requested, via a fast-forward to 0c849d86175340b8d1141acda101d91c551493cb. GitHub now marks #21 merged because its commits are included. Scope: recipe script and the existing three-line rollout debug-fill dependency; no YAML changes. bash -n and git diff --check pass. This transfer adds no new GPU evaluation; runtime dependencies and historical validation caveats remain documented in https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/verl/pull/21. AI assistance: OpenAI Codex. This updates the proposal only; it does not merge #7688 into main.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# DeepSeek-V4 true-on-policy preview for VERL.
+# aligned/quick_alignment_test use batch-invariant vLLM for exact probabilities;
+# baseline-r3 keeps the ordinary mLite actor and routing replay for comparison.
+# Modes: quick_alignment_test (1x4, four layers, two steps), aligned,
+#        baseline-r3.
+# Hardware: h100 (8x8, PP4/CP2/EP16, rollout EP16);
+#           gb200 (8x4, PP1/CP2/EP32, rollout EP8).
+# Images build on `Dockerfile.dsv4_true_on_policy_preview`:
+#   docker://iseekyan/verl:ds4_vllm_align.preview-arm64
+#   docker://iseekyan/verl:ds4_vllm_align.preview-amd64
+# Sources:
+#   VERL_ROOT: verl-project/verl main checkout
+#   MEGATRON_ROOT: Megatron preview branch checkout created with:
+#     git clone --branch ds4_vllm_align_preview \
+#       https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/Megatron-LM.git "${MEGATRON_ROOT}"
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Required env: VERL_ROOT, MEGATRON_ROOT, MODEL_PATH, TRAIN_FILES, VAL_FILES.
+# Optional env: training steps, batch size, lengths, output paths, WANDB_API_KEY,
+# WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_MODE, WANDB_BASE_URL, and Hydra overrides.
+SEED="${SEED:-42}"
+ACTOR_LR="${ACTOR_LR:-1e-6}"
+MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH="${MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH:-2048}"
+PROJECT_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME:-verl-ds4-v4-preview}"
+ACTOR_OPTIMIZER="${ACTOR_OPTIMIZER:-dist_opt}"
+
+VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT_KERNEL_LIB="${VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT_KERNEL_LIB:-/opt/ds4/kernels/_vllm_batch_invariant_C.so}"
+DS4_BI_TOPK_LIB="${DS4_BI_TOPK_LIB:-/opt/ds4/kernels/ds4_bi_topk.so}"
+export VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT_KERNEL_LIB DS4_BI_TOPK_LIB
+
+usage() {
+  echo "usage: $0 --hardware {h100|gb200} --mode {quick_alignment_test|aligned|baseline-r3} [Hydra overrides...]"
+}
+
+die() {
+  printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
+  exit 64
+}
+
+MODE="${MODE:-}"
+HARDWARE="${HARDWARE:-}"
+HYDRA_OVERRIDES=()
+while (( $# > 0 )); do
+  case "$1" in
+    --mode)
+      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "--mode requires a value"
+      MODE="$2"
+      shift 2
+      ;;
+    --hardware)
+      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "--hardware requires a value"
+      HARDWARE="$2"
+      shift 2
+      ;;
+    --help|-h)
+      usage
+      exit 0
+      ;;
+    --)
+      shift
+      HYDRA_OVERRIDES+=("$@")
+      break
+      ;;
+    *)
+      HYDRA_OVERRIDES+=("$1")
+      shift
+      ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+[[ -n "${MODE}" ]] ||
+  die "set --mode quick_alignment_test, aligned, or baseline-r3"
+[[ -n "${HARDWARE}" ]] || die "set --hardware h100 or --hardware gb200"
+[[ "${HARDWARE}" == h100 || "${HARDWARE}" == gb200 ]] || die "unknown hardware: ${HARDWARE}"
+
+# --- Required repositories and inputs ---
+: "${VERL_ROOT:?mount VERL and set VERL_ROOT}"
+: "${MEGATRON_ROOT:?mount ISEEKYAN/Megatron-LM ds4_vllm_align_preview and set MEGATRON_ROOT}"
+: "${MODEL_PATH:?set MODEL_PATH to a DS4 config/tokenizer directory or checkpoint}"
+: "${TRAIN_FILES:?set TRAIN_FILES to DAPO-format training parquet}"
+: "${VAL_FILES:?set VAL_FILES to DAPO-format validation parquet}"
+MLITE_EXAMPLE_ROOT="${MEGATRON_ROOT}/experimental/lite/examples/verl"
+[[ -s "${MODEL_PATH}/config.json" ]] || die "missing ${MODEL_PATH}/config.json"
+
+# --- Mode presets and alignment behavior ---
+case "${MODE}" in
+  quick_alignment_test)
+    EXACT_ALIGNMENT=1
+    : "${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS:=2}"
+    : "${TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE:=4}"
+    : "${PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE:=4}"
+    : "${OVERLONG_BUFFER_LEN:=512}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_N:=1}"
+    : "${MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH:=2048}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_SEQS:=4}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:=0.55}"
+    ;;
+  aligned|baseline-r3)
+    [[ "${MODE}" == aligned ]] && EXACT_ALIGNMENT=1 || EXACT_ALIGNMENT=0
+    : "${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS:=20}"
+    : "${TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE:=32}"
+    : "${PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE:=32}"
+    : "${OVERLONG_BUFFER_LEN:=4096}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_N:=8}"
+    : "${MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH:=8192}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_SEQS:=32}"
+    : "${ROLLOUT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:=0.65}"
+    ;;
+  *)
+    die "unknown mode '${MODE}'"
+    ;;
+esac
+
+case "${ACTOR_OPTIMIZER}" in
+  dist_opt|fsdp2) ;;
+  *) die "ACTOR_OPTIMIZER must be dist_opt or fsdp2, got '${ACTOR_OPTIMIZER}'" ;;
+esac
+
+if [[ -n "${TRAINER_LOGGERS:-}" ]]; then
+  :
+elif [[ "${WANDB_MODE:-}" == disabled ]]; then
+  TRAINER_LOGGERS='[console,file]'
+elif [[ -v WANDB_API_KEY || -v WANDB_ENTITY || -v WANDB_MODE ]]; then
+  TRAINER_LOGGERS='[console,file,wandb]'
+else
+  TRAINER_LOGGERS='[console,file]'
+fi
+
+# Alignment behavior belongs to the mode, not to the hardware profile.
+MODE_ARGS=()
+if [[ "${EXACT_ALIGNMENT}" == 1 ]]; then
+  export VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1
+  export VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse
+  export VERL_FULL_DETERMINISM=1
+  MODE_ARGS=(
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.impl=vllm
+    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.seed="${SEED}"
+    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.full_determinism=True
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.attention_backend_override=null
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.full_determinism=True
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.seed="${SEED}"
+    +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.all2all_backend=deepep_low_latency
+    +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.linear_backend=deep_gemm
+  )
+else
+  export VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=0
+  export VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=paged
+  export VERL_FULL_DETERMINISM=0
+  MODE_ARGS=(
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.attention_backend_override=fused
+    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.impl_cfg.use_deepep=True
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.router_replay_mode=R3

+  )
+fi
+
+OPTIMIZER_ARGS=(
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.impl_cfg.optimizer="${ACTOR_OPTIMIZER}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.param_offload=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.optimizer_offload=True
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config.offload_fraction=1.0
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config.use_precision_aware_optimizer=True
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config.decoupled_weight_decay=True

+# --- Validated hardware profiles ---

+  : "${NGPUS_PER_NODE:=4}"
+  : "${ACTOR_PP:=1}"
+  : "${ACTOR_CP:=1}"
+  : "${ACTOR_EP:=4}"

+  : "${ROLLOUT_EP:=4}"

+  case "${HARDWARE}" in

+      : "${NGPUS_PER_NODE:=8}"
+      : "${ACTOR_PP:=4}"
+      : "${ACTOR_CP:=2}"

+      : "${ROLLOUT_AGENT_WORKERS:=64}"

+      : "${NNODES:=8}"
+      : "${NGPUS_PER_NODE:=4}"
+      : "${ACTOR_PP:=1}"
+      : "${ACTOR_CP:=2}"
+      : "${ACTOR_EP:=32}"
+      : "${ROLLOUT_DP:=8}"
+      : "${ROLLOUT_EP:=8}"

+
+export PYTHONHASHSEED="${SEED}"

+RAY_ENV_NAMES=(

+if [[ "${EXACT_ALIGNMENT}" == 1 ]]; then

+

+
+for name in WANDB_ENTITY WANDB_MODE WANDB_BASE_URL \
+  VLLM_DEEPEP_LOW_LATENCY_USE_MNNVL NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE \
+  VLLM_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR \
+  MLITE_DCP_LOCAL_STAGE_DIR DS4_CHECKPOINT_STAGE_DIR DS4_MCORE_LOCAL_STAGE; do
+  if [[ -v "${name}" ]]; then
+    RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+      "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.${name}=\"${!name}\""
+    )
+  fi
+done
+
+if [[ -n "${NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT:-}" ]]; then
+  RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+    "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=\"${NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT}\""

+
+if [[ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" != 1 ]]; then
+  [[ "${DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS}" == "${NGPUS_PER_NODE}" ]] ||

+fi
+
+# --- Hydra overrides: only non-default preview behavior ---
+HYDRA_ARGS=(
+  # Algorithm and data.
+  algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
+  algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0

+  # vLLM rollout.
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm

+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.data_parallel_size="${ROLLOUT_DP}"

+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization="${ROLLOUT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n="${ROLLOUT_N}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu="${MAX_MODEL_LEN}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len="${MAX_MODEL_LEN}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_seqs="${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_SEQS}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_batched_tokens="${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine.update_weights_bucket_megabytes=1024
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.disable_custom_all_reduce=True
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.worker_extension_cls="${VLLM_WORKER_EXTENSION}"
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.kv_cache_dtype=fp8

+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.expert_dtype=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.activation_scheme=dynamic
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.fmt=e4m3
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.quant_method=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.scale_fmt=ue8m0
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.weight_block_size='[128,128]'
+  # Reward and trainer.
+  reward.reward_manager.name=dapo

+  trainer.logger="${TRAINER_LOGGERS}"
+  trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}"
+  trainer.experiment_name="${RUN_NAME}"

+  trainer.total_training_steps="${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS}"
+  trainer.save_freq="${SAVE_FREQ}"
+  trainer.test_freq="${TEST_FREQ}"
+  trainer.max_actor_ckpt_to_keep=2

detail.body: ### What does this PR do? DeepSeek-V4 true-on-policy GRPO/DAPO on verl + mLite + vLLM. - **Composable actor, not a core patch:** built on Megatron Agent-Compose (mLite) under `experimental/lite/`. Model behavior is assembled through protocols and primitives instead of an invasive Megatron-core patch stack. The vLLM-aligned pieces can be reused by other models or swapped for a future SGLang path. - **W8A8:** BF16 master weights, E4M3 block-FP8 deployment weights, dynamic FP8 activations. Actor and rollout share the same W8A8 path after reload. - **Hopper and Blackwell:** validated on H100, GB200, and GB300. - **Preview dependencies, later split/merge:** https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54955, https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7050. - **Exact 0-diff logprobs:** after update and reload, `training/rollout_probs_diff_* == 0` and `rollout_corr/k3_kl == 0` — not an epsilon threshold. - **~10% perf overhead, still being optimized:** GB200 32-GPU, generate is nearly unchanged; the remaining gap is in the batch-invariant actor path. ### results ### Acknowledgements Thanks to [@zhuzilin](https://github.com/zhuzilin) and the contributors to [THUDM/slime#2262](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/pull/2262). ### Contributors - Yan Bai ([@ISEEKYAN](https://github.com/ISEEKYAN)): preview architecture, DS4 vLLM/mLite integration, deterministic execution, weight synchronization, recipe, and hardware validation. - [@aoshen02](https://github.com/aoshen02): vLLM verification and speedup. - Kaixiang Lei ([@shyoshyo](https://github.com/shyoshyo)): DeepSeek-V4 gradient checkpointing, HF export, THD label alignment, and microbatch output handling. - [@andakai](https://github.com/andakai) and [@zobinHuang](https://github.com/zobinHuang) optimized the performance of the batch-invariant vLLM execution path.

@@ -0,0 +1,281 @@
+# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Base image and release pins
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ARG BASE_IMAGE=nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3
+ARG BASE_IMAGE_DIGEST=sha256:2140e699b3beaf7f96a0081fd9c9406bc3832b435cdb60dfa2d261f7d2f34a1c
+ARG TARGETARCH=amd64
+
+# Among the three application repositories in this preview, only vLLM is
+# baked into the image. VERL and Megatron-LM are mounted at run time.
+ARG VLLM_REPO=https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/vllm.git
+ARG VLLM_REF=refs/heads/ds4-v9-rc1
+ARG VLLM_REVISION=168a040e0a983404e78ea86c367be0cfa80424fd
+ARG VLLM_TREE=8ebbe4006d30144fe0d1243e2aa865a2911e9d54
+
+ARG DEEPGEMM_REPO=https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/DeepGEMM.git
+ARG DEEPGEMM_REVISION=dfad2230d33ac6bb853b00e56a1c94664f4fe195
+ARG DEEPEP_REPO=https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/DeepEP.git
+ARG DEEPEP_REVISION=2cd85412155cbc07452f552ac6e2f446a26f8869
+ARG HYBRIDEP_REPO=https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP.git
+ARG HYBRIDEP_REVISION=58397eac493b075b0baea5861ac6e9793d8d7a21
+ARG MAX_JOBS=64
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Builder
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}@${BASE_IMAGE_DIGEST} AS builder
+ARG TARGETARCH
+ARG BASE_IMAGE
+ARG BASE_IMAGE_DIGEST
+ARG VLLM_REPO
+ARG VLLM_REF
+ARG VLLM_REVISION
+ARG VLLM_TREE
+ARG DEEPGEMM_REPO
+ARG DEEPGEMM_REVISION
+ARG DEEPEP_REPO
+ARG DEEPEP_REVISION
+ARG HYBRIDEP_REPO
+ARG HYBRIDEP_REVISION
+ARG MAX_JOBS
+
+ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/ds4-venv \
+    PATH=/opt/ds4-venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin \
+    MAX_JOBS=${MAX_JOBS} CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=${MAX_JOBS} \
+    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
+    TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/src/build/torch-extensions
+WORKDIR /src
+
+RUN apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update && \
+    apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y --no-install-recommends \
+      libdw-dev libelf-dev && \
+    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Target architecture and source checkouts
+# x86_64: H100 (SM90), B200 (SM100), B300 (SM103)
+# arm64:  GB200 (SM100), GB300 (SM103)
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN <<'EOF'
+set -eux
+case "${TARGETARCH}" in
+  amd64)
+    torch_archs='9.0a;10.0a;10.3a'
+    cuda_archs='90a;100a;103a'
+    ;;
+  arm64)
+    torch_archs='10.0a;10.3a'
+    cuda_archs='100a;103a'
+    ;;
+  *) exit 64 ;;
+esac
+printf "export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST='%s'\nexport CUDAARCHS='%s'\n" \
+  "${torch_archs}" "${cuda_archs}" >/tmp/ds4-arch.env
+
+clone_exact() {
+  git init "/src/$1"
+  git -C "/src/$1" remote add origin "$2"
+  git -C "/src/$1" fetch --depth 1 origin "$3"
+  git -C "/src/$1" checkout --detach "$3"
+  test "$(git -C "/src/$1" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$3"
+}
+
+git init /src/vllm
+git -C /src/vllm remote add origin "${VLLM_REPO}"
+git -C /src/vllm fetch --depth 2048 origin "${VLLM_REF}"
+git -C /src/vllm checkout --detach "${VLLM_REVISION}"
+test "$(git -C /src/vllm rev-parse HEAD)" = "${VLLM_REVISION}"
+test "$(git -C /src/vllm rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "${VLLM_TREE}"
+
+clone_exact DeepGEMM "${DEEPGEMM_REPO}" "${DEEPGEMM_REVISION}"
+clone_exact DeepEP "${DEEPEP_REPO}" "${DEEPEP_REVISION}"
+git -C /src/DeepGEMM submodule update --init --depth 1
+
+python3 -m pip install uv==0.12.5
+uv venv --seed --system-site-packages --python "$(command -v python3)" "${VIRTUAL_ENV}"
+EOF
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Python runtime and vLLM wheel built from the pinned source tree
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv <<'EOF'
+set -eux
+uv pip install PyYAML==6.0.3 pyarrow==25.0.1 datasets==5.0.1 \
+  jsonschema==4.26.0 wheel==0.48.0 ninja==1.13.0 cmake==4.4.2 \
+  packaging==25.0 setuptools==80.10.2 build==1.3.0 "setuptools-rust>=1.9.0" \
+  "setuptools-scm>=8.0" pytest==9.1.1 tblib==3.2.2 \
+  accelerate==1.14.0 codetiming==1.4.0 hydra-core==1.4.0.dev8 \
+  peft==0.20.0 pylatexenc==3.0b2 "ray[default]==2.57.0" tensordict==0.10.0 \
+  torchaudio==2.11.0 torchvision==0.28.0
+uv pip install -r /src/vllm/requirements/common.txt
+uv pip install --extra-index-url https://flashinfer.ai/whl/ \
+  flashinfer-python==0.6.18 flashinfer-cubin==0.6.18 \
+  numba==0.65.0 "torchcodec>=0.14" PyNvVideoCodec==2.0.4 \
+  apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.11 nvtx==0.2.15 "fastsafetensors>=0.3.3" \
+  tokenspeed-mla==0.1.8 "humming-kernels[cu13]==0.1.12" \
+  tilelang==0.1.12 nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.27.0 \
+  "nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]==4.6.2" quack-kernels==0.6.4
+
+. /tmp/ds4-arch.env
+mkdir -p /tmp/wheels/vllm
+(cd /src/vllm && /opt/ds4-venv/bin/python -m build --wheel \
+  --no-isolation --outdir /tmp/wheels/vllm)
+wheel=$(find /tmp/wheels/vllm -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'vllm-*.whl' \
+  -print -quit)
+test -n "${wheel}"
+mkdir -p /opt/ds4
+sha256sum "${wheel}" | cut -d' ' -f1 >/opt/ds4/vllm-wheel.sha256
+uv pip install --no-deps "${wheel}"
+uv pip check || true
+EOF
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# DS4 batch-invariant CUDA kernels
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN <<'EOF'
+set -eux
+. /tmp/ds4-arch.env
+case "${TARGETARCH}" in
+  amd64) gencode='-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a;-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a;-gencode=arch=compute_103a,code=sm_103a' ;;
+  arm64) gencode='-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a;-gencode=arch=compute_103a,code=sm_103a' ;;
+esac
+mkdir -p /tmp/ds4-kernels /opt/ds4/kernels
+cat >/tmp/ds4-kernels/CMakeLists.txt <<'CMAKE'
+cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
+project(ds4_batch_invariant LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
+set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
+set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)
+set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES OFF)
+find_package(Python3 3.12 EXACT COMPONENTS Development REQUIRED)
+find_package(Torch REQUIRED)
+set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${TORCH_CXX_FLAGS}")
+set(CMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS} ${TORCH_CXX_FLAGS}")
+
+add_library(_vllm_batch_invariant_C SHARED
+  /src/vllm/csrc/batch_invariant/fused_silu_mul_per_token_group_quant.cu
+  /src/vllm/csrc/batch_invariant/sparse_index.cu
+  /src/vllm/csrc/batch_invariant/top_k.cu
+  /src/vllm/csrc/batch_invariant/torch_bindings.cpp)
+target_include_directories(_vllm_batch_invariant_C PRIVATE /src/vllm/csrc)
+
+foreach(target _vllm_batch_invariant_C)
+  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE ${TORCH_LIBRARIES} Python3::Python)
+  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--use_fast_math>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--expt-extended-lambda>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-U__CUDA_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-U__CUDA_NO_HALF_CONVERSIONS__>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_CONVERSIONS__>
+    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-U__CUDA_NO_HALF2_OPERATORS__>)
+  foreach(flag IN LISTS DS4_CUDA_GENCODE)
+    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:${flag}>)
+  endforeach()
+  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES PREFIX ""
+    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY /opt/ds4/kernels)
+endforeach()
+CMAKE
+cmake -S /tmp/ds4-kernels -B /tmp/ds4-kernels/build -G Ninja \
+  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
+  -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/torch/share/cmake \
+  -DDS4_CUDA_GENCODE="${gencode}"
+cmake --build /tmp/ds4-kernels/build --parallel "${MAX_JOBS}"
+EOF
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# DeepGEMM and per-node DeepEP variants
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv <<'EOF'
+set -eux
+. /tmp/ds4-arch.env
+mkdir -p /tmp/wheels/deepgemm /tmp/wheels/nvl4 /tmp/wheels/nvl8
+(cd /src/DeepGEMM && CPATH=/usr/local/cuda/include/cccl \
+  DISABLE_AGGRESSIVE_PTX_INSTRS=1 \
+  python3 -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation -w /tmp/wheels/deepgemm .)
+uv pip install --no-deps /tmp/wheels/deepgemm/*.whl
+for peers in 4 8; do
+  rm -rf /src/DeepEP/build /src/DeepEP/*.egg-info
+  (cd /src/DeepEP && DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_NVL_PEERS="${peers}" \
+    CPATH=/usr/local/cuda/include/cccl \
+    python3 -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation \
+      -w "/tmp/wheels/nvl${peers}" .)
+  python3 -m pip install --no-deps --no-compile \
+    --target "/opt/ds4/overlays/deepep-nvl${peers}/site-packages" \
+    "/tmp/wheels/nvl${peers}"/*.whl
+done
+EOF
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HybridEP multi-node support
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ENV HYBRID_EP_MULTINODE=1 RDMA_CORE_HOME=/opt/rdma-core/build
+RUN <<'EOF'
+set -eux
+. /tmp/ds4-arch.env
+apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update
+apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y --no-install-recommends \
+  rdma-core libibverbs-dev libnvidia-ml-dev
+arch_lib="$(dpkg-architecture -qDEB_HOST_MULTIARCH)"
+mkdir -p "${RDMA_CORE_HOME}"
+ln -sfn /usr/include "${RDMA_CORE_HOME}/include"

+ROLLOUT_TP="${ROLLOUT_TP:-1}"
+MAX_MODEL_LEN=$((MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH + MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH))
+ACTOR_ARGS=(
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.pp="${ACTOR_PP}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.cp="${ACTOR_CP}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.ep="${ACTOR_EP}"
+  '~actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.grad_offload'
+  '~actor_rollout_ref.ref.engine.grad_offload'
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.cross_entropy_fusion=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.resync_format=block_fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.resync_config.expert_dtype=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.actor.engine.impl_cfg.recompute=full
+)
+ENGINE_ARGS=("hydra.searchpath=[file://${runtime_config_root},pkg://verl_mlite.config]" model_engine=mlite)
+if [[ "${MODE}" == baseline-r3 ]]; then
+  [[ "${HARDWARE}" == gb200 ]] || die "MXFP8 baseline requires Blackwell; use --hardware gb200"
+  [[ "${ACTOR_OPTIMIZER}" == dist_opt ]] || die "Megatron baseline requires dist_opt"
+  ENGINE_ARGS=(model_engine=megatron)
+  ACTOR_ARGS=(
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size="${ACTOR_PP}"
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.context_parallel_size="${ACTOR_CP}"
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.expert_model_parallel_size="${ACTOR_EP}"
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.param_offload=False
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.optimizer_offload=False
+    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config.chunked_optimizer_state_offload=True
+    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.override_optimizer_config.optimizer_state_offload_chunk_size_mb=1024
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.fp8=e4m3
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.fp8_recipe=mxfp8
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_granularity=full
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_method=uniform
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.recompute_num_layers=1
+  )
+  if (( ACTOR_CP > 1 )); then
+    ACTOR_ARGS+=(
+      ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.cp_partition_mode=contiguous
+      ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.sequence_packing_scheduler=dp_balanced
+      ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.override_transformer_config.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank="$((MAX_MODEL_LEN / ACTOR_CP))"
+    )
+  fi
+  OPTIMIZER_ARGS=()
+fi
+OUTPUT_ROOT="${OUTPUT_ROOT:-/workspace/outputs/ds4_true_on_policy_preview/${HARDWARE}/${MODE}}"
+RUN_NAME="${RUN_NAME:-ds4_v4_${HARDWARE}_${MODE//-/_}}"
+CKPT_DIR="${CKPT_DIR:-${OUTPUT_ROOT}/checkpoints/${RUN_NAME}}"
+LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-${OUTPUT_ROOT}/${RUN_NAME}.log}"
+JSONL_FILE="${JSONL_FILE:-${OUTPUT_ROOT}/${RUN_NAME}.jsonl}"
+if [[ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" != 1 && "${NNODES}" -gt 1 ]]; then
+  : "${RAY_ADDRESS:?multi-node modes require an existing Ray cluster}"
+fi
+
+mkdir -p \
+  "${OUTPUT_ROOT}" \
+  "${CKPT_DIR}" \
+  "$(dirname "${LOG_FILE}")" \
+  "$(dirname "${JSONL_FILE}")"
+export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="${JSONL_FILE}"
+
+# --- Internal container/Ray environment; normally do not edit ---
+export RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
+export PATH="/opt/ds4-venv/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
+export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
+export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
+export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/compat/lib.real:/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
+
+export NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS="${NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS:-7}"
+export NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NCCL="${NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NCCL:-1}"
+export VLLM_DEEPEP_BUFFER_SIZE_MB="${VLLM_DEEPEP_BUFFER_SIZE_MB:-1024}"
+export DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS="${DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS:-${NGPUS_PER_NODE}}"
+export ACTOR_MOE_DISPATCHER=deepep
+export NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN="${NGPUS_PER_NODE}"
+
+export PYTHONHASHSEED="${SEED}"
+export PYTHONPATH="/opt/ds4/overlays/deepep-nvl${NGPUS_PER_NODE}/site-packages:${VERL_ROOT}:${MEGATRON_ROOT}:${MEGATRON_ROOT}/experimental/lite:${MLITE_EXAMPLE_ROOT}:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
+unset HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES LD_PRELOAD
+
+if [[ "${NNODES}" == 1 ]]; then
+  export NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none
+else
+  unset NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT
+  export NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING="${NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING:-1}"
+  export NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST="${NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST:-mlx5_0:1,mlx5_1:1,mlx5_3:1,mlx5_4:1}"
+  export NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_FAMILY="${NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_FAMILY:-AF_INET6}"
+  export NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_RANGE="${NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_RANGE:-fe80::/10}"
+  export NVSHMEM_IB_GID_INDEX="${NVSHMEM_IB_GID_INDEX:-0}"
+fi
+
+# Exporting in this launcher is not enough for an existing Ray cluster.
+RAY_ENV_NAMES=(
+  PATH PYTHONPATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+  PYTHONNOUSERSITE
+  RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
+  PYTHONHASHSEED VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT VERL_FULL_DETERMINISM
+  VERL_ROLLOUT_DISABLE_DEBUG_FILL
+  DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS NVSHMEM_MAX_TEAMS NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NCCL
+  VLLM_DEEPEP_BUFFER_SIZE_MB
+  ACTOR_MOE_DISPATCHER NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN
+  VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH
+)
+if [[ "${EXACT_ALIGNMENT}" == 1 ]]; then
+  RAY_ENV_NAMES+=(VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT_KERNEL_LIB)
+fi
+RAY_RUNTIME_ENV=()
+for name in "${RAY_ENV_NAMES[@]}"; do
+  RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+    "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.${name}=\"${!name}\""
+  )
+done
+
+if (( NNODES > 1 )); then
+  for name in NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST \
+    NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_FAMILY NVSHMEM_IB_ADDR_RANGE NVSHMEM_IB_GID_INDEX; do
+    RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+      "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.${name}=\"${!name}\""
+    )
+  done
+fi
+
+for name in WANDB_ENTITY WANDB_MODE WANDB_BASE_URL \
+  VLLM_DEEPEP_LOW_LATENCY_USE_MNNVL NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE \
+  VLLM_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR \
+  MLITE_DCP_LOCAL_STAGE_DIR DS4_CHECKPOINT_STAGE_DIR DS4_MCORE_LOCAL_STAGE; do
+  if [[ -v "${name}" ]]; then
+    RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+      "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.${name}=\"${!name}\""
+    )
+  fi
+done
+
+if [[ -n "${NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT:-}" ]]; then
+  RAY_RUNTIME_ENV+=(
+    "+ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=\"${NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT}\""
+  )
+fi
+
+if [[ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" != 1 ]]; then
+  [[ "${DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS}" == "${NGPUS_PER_NODE}" ]] ||
+    die "DEEPEP_MAX_NVL_PEERS must equal NGPUS_PER_NODE"
+  if [[ "${EXACT_ALIGNMENT}" == 1 ]]; then
+    [[ -s "${VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT_KERNEL_LIB}" ]] ||
+      die "missing batch-invariant kernel"
+  fi
+  IFS=, read -r -a train_files <<<"${TRAIN_FILES}"
+  IFS=, read -r -a val_files <<<"${VAL_FILES}"
+  for file in "${train_files[@]}"; do
+    [[ -f "${file}" ]] || die "missing train file: ${file}"
+  done
+  for file in "${val_files[@]}"; do
+    [[ -f "${file}" ]] || die "missing validation file: ${file}"
+  done
+fi
+
+# --- Hydra overrides: only non-default preview behavior ---
+HYDRA_ARGS=(
+  # Algorithm and data.
+  algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
+  algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0
+  algorithm.norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=False
+  data.train_files="${TRAIN_FILES}"
+  data.val_files="${VAL_FILES}"
+  data.train_batch_size="${TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE}"
+  data.seed="${SEED}"
+  data.max_prompt_length="${MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH}"
+  data.max_response_length="${MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH}"
+  +data.apply_chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=True
+
+  # Model and shared actor settings.
+  actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.model.trust_remote_code=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.weight_decay=0.1
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.betas='[0.9,0.95]'
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr="${ACTOR_LR}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr_warmup_steps=0
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size="${PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu="${PPO_MAX_TOKEN_LEN_PER_GPU:-${MAX_MODEL_LEN}}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28
+  actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_c=10.0
+
+  # vLLM rollout.
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size="${ROLLOUT_TP}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.data_parallel_size="${ROLLOUT_DP}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.expert_parallel_size="${ROLLOUT_EP}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers="${ROLLOUT_AGENT_WORKERS}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization="${ROLLOUT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n="${ROLLOUT_N}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs=True
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu="${MAX_MODEL_LEN}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len="${MAX_MODEL_LEN}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_seqs="${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_SEQS}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_batched_tokens="${ROLLOUT_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS}"
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine.update_weights_bucket_megabytes=1024
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.disable_custom_all_reduce=True
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.worker_extension_cls="${VLLM_WORKER_EXTENSION}"
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.kv_cache_dtype=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.moe_backend="${ROLLOUT_MOE_BACKEND}"
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.expert_dtype=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.activation_scheme=dynamic
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.fmt=e4m3
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.quant_method=fp8
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.scale_fmt=ue8m0
+  +actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.hf_overrides.quantization_config.weight_block_size='[128,128]'
+  # Reward and trainer.
+  reward.reward_manager.name=dapo
+  +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.enable=True
+  +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.len="${OVERLONG_BUFFER_LEN}"
+  +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.penalty_factor=1.0
+  +reward.reward_kwargs.overlong_buffer_cfg.log=False
+  +reward.reward_kwargs.max_resp_len="${MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH}"
+  trainer.logger="${TRAINER_LOGGERS}"
+  trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}"
+  trainer.experiment_name="${RUN_NAME}"
+  trainer.n_gpus_per_node="${NGPUS_PER_NODE}"
+  trainer.nnodes="${NNODES}"
+  trainer.total_training_steps="${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS}"
+  trainer.save_freq="${SAVE_FREQ}"
+  trainer.test_freq="${TEST_FREQ}"
+  trainer.max_actor_ckpt_to_keep=2
+  trainer.default_local_dir="${CKPT_DIR}"
+  trainer.val_before_train=False
+  trainer.use_v1=False

Updated the PR source branch in `640c5f0a` after validating the corresponding
vLLM revision (`ISEEKYAN/vllm@168a040e`, merged as ISEEKYAN/vllm#22).

Changes:
- build the vLLM wheel and unified BI CUDA extension from the same pinned source
  tree instead of combining an older wheel with a Python overlay;
- include the fused sparse-index CUDA source and record wheel/library hashes in
  an image-closure manifest;
- keep CUDA Graph at the vLLM default (`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`);
- do not enable MNNVL by default; only propagate it when the caller sets it.

Validation:
- pre-commit passed for both modified recipe files;
- unified ARM64 CUDA library build and 10/10 eager/CUDA-Graph bitwise operator
  comparisons passed;
- 8-node fixed-output rollout A/B used identical step-0 inputs (1,024 requests,
  8,388,608 response tokens): BI=0 45.7706 vs BI=1 43.3193 response tokens/ms,
  a 5.36% BI gap.

This updates the existing DS4 preview recipe rather than duplicating it. AI
assistance (OpenAI Codex) was used; the human maintainer should review the
changed lines and validation before merging.

Applied the changes from ISEEKYAN/verl#21 directly to this PR head branch, as requested, via a fast-forward to 0c849d86175340b8d1141acda101d91c551493cb. GitHub now marks #21 merged because its commits are included. Scope: recipe script and the existing three-line rollout debug-fill dependency; no YAML changes. bash -n and git diff --check pass. This transfer adds no new GPU evaluation; runtime dependencies and historical validation caveats remain documented in https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/verl/pull/21. AI assistance: OpenAI Codex. This updates the proposal only; it does not merge #7688 into main.
